nvidia.credit: NVIDIA SimReady Assets, resized, reoriented and adapted for Quack Café

pollen.motion: Static authored pose; no locomotion policy

motion.engine: Newton 1.7 / SolverMuJoCo native CPU backend, imported by ovnewton

sugar_cube.adaptation: Source visual and supplied collision meshes scaled 1.8, with explicit convex-envelope mass approximation.

adaptations.source_props: HF household meshes at uniform scale. A drilled source wooden spatula pivots beside a drilled source mug tree. A 3 mm steel-finish axle uses the source tube_a02 circular profile sized to length. A complete HF CabinetHandle002 supplies the stop, including its rounded corners and mounting feet. The source PVC rails end behind the handle with a measured gap; these parts have no overlap exemptions. The final wide board and uphill approach use source cutting boards. No scripted release or launch impulse.
adaptations.rope: Generated cord display follows the solved tension-only mechanism. It supplies no body forces or motion.
adaptations.mass_properties: See scene layout and validation scope for densities, carton contents, wheel inertia and convex-envelope approximations.
adaptations.starter: Uniformly scaled NVIDIA cutting board on a passive hinge, with a source-tube axle. Ideal fixed bearing; no pedal drive or scripted impulse. The two existing notebook platform assets are recessed by 22 mm for clearance. Torque-limited foot servo includes gravity compensation.
adaptations.workstations: Three stainless table assemblies replaced by eight complete fixture_cabinet_b01 modules at uniform scale. Original tabletop support heights retained. Cream drawer fronts, espresso body material variants, original wood and chrome surfaces.
adaptations.robot_finish: Cream shell plastics, dusty rose feet and lower head, darker rose soft jaw. Original Pollen mesh positions, joints, bearings, electronics, servos and black optics retained.

articulated_beetle.scope: Original mesh parts and solid PBR factors, uniformly scaled. Four wheel assemblies separated at their published mesh boundaries. Proper Y-up to Z-up rotation; no geometry reshaping.

physics.funnel_role: Counter prop only: bent narrow spout is unsuitable for the 36 mm payload.

parking_stop.scope: Whole source carton, uniformly scaled 1.4 and fixed to the ramp as a physical end stop.

physics.scope: Original HF Objaverse Beetle, uniformly 0.08 scale; declared 300 g body and four 5 g wheels. Free chassis, four unpowered X-axis revolute wheel joints, source-mesh hull contacts (512-vertex tire hull budget). Chassis inertia from its convex envelope; wheels use solid-cylinder inertia. No motor or prescribed vehicle trajectory.

render_appearance.scope: Render-only dark coffee surface with a small meniscus. No collider, fluid forces, splashes or dissolution. Original audited rigid-body trajectory and contact-triggered celebration retained.

marble_return.scope: A passive hanging wooden spatula nudges sugar from a fixed ledge. A drilled source mug-tree peg supports the axle. An uphill board slows the marble; a complete source cabinet handle stops the blade while the smaller sugar cube passes underneath into a mug on a low café table, with its rim slightly below the ledge. Fixed mount and handle feet; separate rails have no overlap exemption; no motor or scripted release in the finale.

pipe_fit.joint_type: Complete source cabinet handle, with integral rounded grip and feet. Separate guard rails end behind it.

carton_initialization.scope: Initial carton poses sampled from a gravity-settled, no-kick run; initialized at rest, then remain unconstrained dynamic rigid bodies. Six-dimensional contact enables the model’s existing torsional and rolling friction coefficients. No locks, kinematic releases or motion edits.

pipe_stock.adaptation: One straight pipe separated from the published bundle, uniformly scaled to diameter, then cut to length. Exposed annular end faces are cut surfaces. Original grey PVC material retained.

celebration.trigger: Sugar inside mug and in contact with its interior for 0.12 s
celebration.scope: Finite-torque head-pitch reactions to measured chain progress, followed by two nods only after sustained sugar contact inside the cup. Fixed base; declared prototype inertia, no walking or perception policy.
